item.title: Bulletin updated at 20:35 HKT 25/Jun/2024
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
Under the influence of the subtropical ridge, the weather will be generally fine and very hot over southeastern China in the next couple of days. A southwesterly airstream is expected to bring showers and thunderstorms to the coast of Guangdong during the weekend and early next week. It will still be hot over the region. The subtropical ridge will cover southeastern China again midweek next week.
